# PKG Fiscal 2004 Financial Figures

## Figures
- **Net Sales (Change):** $154.6 million (from 2003 to 2004)
- **Net Sales (2003):** $1,735.5 million
- **Net Sales (2004):** $1,890.1 million
- **Net Income (Loss) (2004):** $68.7 million

## Percent Increase in Net Sales from 2003 to 2004
To calculate the percent increase in net sales from 2003 to 2004:

\[ \text{Percent Increase} = \left( \frac{\text{Net Sales (2004)} - \text{Net Sales (2003)}}{\text{Net Sales (2003)}} \right) \times 100 \]

Substituting the values:

\[ \text{Percent Increase} = \left( \frac{1890.1 - 1735.5}{1735.5} \right) \times 100 \approx 8.93\% \]

## Source Files
- **Net Sales (Change):** `documents/report.md`
- **Net Sales (2003):** `documents/report.md`
- **Net Sales (2004):** `documents/report.md`
- **Net Income (Loss) (2004):** `documents/report.md`

All figures are from the audited financial statements in the 10-K report.

To calculate the percent increase in net sales from 2003 to 2004:

\[ \text{Percent Increase} = \left( \frac{\text{Net Sales (2004)} - \text{Net Sales (2003)}}{\text{Net Sales (2003)}} \right) \times 100 \]

Substituting the values:

\[ \text{Percent Increase} = \left( \frac{1890.1 - 1735.5}{1735.5} \right) \times 100 \approx 8.93\% \]
